component.name: MULTI1Dvisual
component.summary: Explore spatial profiles and time series from MULTI1D simulations
查看 MULTI1D 模拟的空间剖面和时间序列

description.p: Open MULTI1D output files, compare curves at several times and inspect space–time heatmaps. Figures and data tables can be exported from the viewer.
打开 MULTI1D 输出文件，比较不同时刻的曲线，查看时空热图，并导出图片和数据表。
